//TR: Bu checkpoint Founder'ın 2026-10-02 tek seferlik otonomi kurulumu talebini kaydeder: tek bir incelenmiş bootstrap betiği, gizli pencereli görev sarmalayıcısı ve kararlı görev girişi; kurulumdan sonra rutin işler için Founder komutu gerekmez. Tasarım dört bağımsız açıdan eleştirildi, bulgular uygulandı ve sınırlar açıkça kaydedildi.
founderDirective: Founder request 2026-10-02: finish the autonomy bootstrap as a single bounded one-time installation operation: one reviewed bootstrap script that performs only the approved one-time host setup (task registration, canonical control-plane path, working directory, logon/recovery triggers, restart behaviour, heartbeat, single-worker locking, durable state recovery, secure local signer integration); validated by deterministic and adversarial tests (path validation, no shell injection, no credential logging, no force push, no trust weakening); at most one command for the unavoidable OS bootstrap; afterwards the supervisor rediscovers repository truth, recovers the queue, handles both reviewers, persists quota retries and wakes on its own, remediates, integrates, releases, signs locally and runs Phase0; the Claude Desktop workflow and Routine are not required; the routine stays passive; no sleeping Claude session; the Codex retry is owned by the supervisor; the bootstrap state is persisted and never repeated unless broken.

founderAuthorization.rule: Explicit Founder request of 2026-10-02 for a single reviewed one-time bootstrap; the protected files strictly necessary for it are authorized; every change keeps or strengthens trust: the task runs only reviewed, trust-root-verified planes with no stored password, and older planes can no longer review, merge or release packages that require dual review or the release audit.
founderAuthorization.constraint: one-time host setup only; no elevation, no stored password, no S4U, no startup trigger, no credential access, no push, no change to Windows services or security settings; the bootstrap refuses an elevated or packaged-app session and an active Global Stop

design.bootstrap: scripts/bootstrap-uasco-autonomy.ps1: normal user session only; one path validator for every value in the task command line (no quote, %, backtick, bracket, wildcard, control character, drive root or trailing separator/dot/space); MSIX virtualization probe; Global Stop fail-closed including unreadable and .prev; provenance of its own checkout (tracked, clean, no assume-unchanged/skip-worktree flag, blob identical to HEAD); Git isolation identical to automation/lib/git-isolation.mjs plus an empty clone template; plane = governed default-branch commit; trust root and durable queue verified with the plane's own library before dependencies; npm ci from the reviewed lock (a dependency source only in test mode); byte-identical install of the entry and the wrapper; activation under the single-worker lock with CONTROL_PLANE_ACTIVATED; one CIM task builder used for test facts, registration, read-back comparison and the self-removing registration probe; first run confirmed only from the task process heartbeat; record and repository mirror
design.task: UASCO-Autonomous-Supervisor: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File <controlRoot>\bootstrap\uasco-supervisor-task.ps1 -Repo <repo> -Node <node.exe>; working directory the control root; triggers at logon (this user) and every 15 minutes indefinitely; IgnoreNew, StartWhenAvailable, no time limit, restart 3 x 1 minute, batteries allowed, priority 5; principal this user, Interactive, Limited, no stored password
design.entry: scripts/uasco-supervisor-entry.mjs: link resolution with self-repair only to the CURRENT.json plane (HEAD equals the record, trust root verified) and pointing a disagreeing link back to the recorded bootstrapped or governed plane; provenance (directory named by HEAD, CURRENT.json agrees, HEAD bootstrapped or governed); plane trust root before any import; control-root match; delegation to a governed plane copy of the entry (BS1+) or to the AUT2 launcher with a frozen-heartbeat tree kill; AUT1B tick loop (15 minutes) with a hang backstop that kills the tree and clears the dead tick's lock; once the default branch has the launcher the old tick never runs again and only one governed upgrade is attempted (governed merge, fast-forward, candidate trust root, identical-lock dependencies, single-worker lock, CONTROL_PLANE_UPGRADED), otherwise UPGRADE_BLOCKED; an old plane never enters an open release lane; Global Stop honoured; statuses: entry heartbeat, repository BOOTSTRAP_STATUS.json and, before the daemon, a labelled pre-daemon WATCHDOG_STATUS.json with staleAfterSeconds
design.chain: DR1 activation holds and DR2 release-audit activation (in those packages) plus queue holds: DR2 held until DUAL_REVIEW_ACTIVE, BS1 (release package) held until RELEASE_AUDIT_ACTIVE, so no older plane can review, merge or release them

disclosedLimits: no pre-logon start (S4U cannot use the ssh-agent key; stored passwords not allowed)
does not wake a sleeping PC

installed copies replaced only by a new bootstrap, governed plane copy used from BS1 on
Claude sessions must not run --tick or --daemon after the bootstrap

adversarialReview.workflow: bs1 adversarial verification of the implemented package (lenses: entry state machine, bootstrap PowerShell, security, coverage honesty); 13 findings confirmed (2 MEDIUM, 11 LOW), all fixed before the commit
fixes: MEDIUM link self-repair could heal to current.next or previous.path and then fail provenance forever -> a missing link is repaired only to the CURRENT.json plane whose HEAD equals the record (current.next only when it is that plane); a link that disagrees with CURRENT.json is pointed back to the recorded, trust-verified, bootstrapped or governed plane (LINK_REPAIRED)

MEDIUM first-run verdict ignored a failed tick (SLEEPING overwrote TICK_FINISHED) and confirmed delegation states before the child ran -> any fresh failure state or non-zero/timed-out tick fails; launcher delegation confirms only from a fresh daemon heartbeat or a still-running task at the deadline; LAUNCHER_EXITED and STOPPED fail
LOW frozen-heartbeat watch killed a healthy daemon after sleep or one unreadable read -> last good beat kept, .prev fallback, suspend gap resets the baseline, two consecutive stale polls required
LOW tick status parsed a nested provider status -> logs/last-tick.json written by the tick, else the top-level status line only
LOW repository mirror lost firstRun and signer -> the record is re-read on every write and both are carried
LOW re-bootstrap refused during any release -> refused only for a plane without the launcher or without the required final release audit
LOW the superseded register script switches control\current before its conflict check -> documented as must not be run
LOW pre-launcher upgrade ignored a Global Stop raised while it ran -> contract runner with shouldStop, recheck under the lock in activatePlane, check before the launcher starts
LOW -TestMode could write the live repository -> test mode requires a repository under TEMP without reparse points (TEST_MODE_REQUIRES_TEMP_REPO)

claudeReviewerAdvisoryRound.run: pre-activation CLAUDE_REVIEWER review of the frozen e4bca6c bundle (advisory evidence root .ai/cache/review/pre-activation-claude, run e4bca6c-c1-20261002T012208426Z-orchestrator-claude)

claudeReviewerAdvisoryRound.readableContent: the raw output stated result CLEAN with five ADVISORY findings, all applied before this commit
fixes: F-BS1-ADV-001 (P2) a pre-launcher first tick still running at the 180 s deadline was recorded as INSTALLED -> the bootstrap waits up to 900 s for a running first tick; if it is still running the verdict is FIRST_RUN_TICK_IN_PROGRESS and the status INSTALLED_FIRST_TICK_PENDING (Resolve-DeadlineVerdict, Get-InstallStatus); the entry settles the tick result into BOOTSTRAP_INSTALLED.json once (INSTALLED or FIRST_RUN_FAILED); documented and covered

F-BS1-ADV-002 (P2) an unresolved default branch or a failed launcher probe degraded to 'no launcher' and ran the old tick -> 'no launcher' is only the empty result of a successful ls-tree; otherwise UPGRADE_BLOCKED (DEFAULT_BRANCH_UNRESOLVED or LAUNCHER_PROBE_FAILED), covered by a deleted master branch and a commit whose tree is missing

F-BS1-ADV-003 (P2) the tick-loop and upgrade dependencies on the real pre-launcher plane were unverified -> the entry checks the plane library surface before use (PLANE_LIBRARY_SURFACE_MISSING) and a scenario runs the tick loop, timeout cleanup and governed upgrade on the real AUT1B tree
F-BS1-ADV-004 (P3) the bootstrap read a Global Stop file with active false as no stop -> any present Global Stop file (or .prev) refuses with GLOBAL_STOP_ACTIVE, as automation/lib/global-stop.mjs
F-BS1-ADV-005 (P3) the DR2 policy sentence had moved into the BS1 line of .ai/REVIEW_STATUS.md -> restored to the DR2 line

finalAdversarialVerification.workflow: bs1-final-adversarial-verification (five independent lenses on snapshot 865330e: entry runtime, bootstrap PowerShell, security, integration with the real AUT1B/AUT2/DR planes, coverage honesty; one skeptic per finding tried to refute it against the code)
fixes: MEDIUM BS1-ENTRY-01/INT-01 an AUT1B merge of the launcher package interrupted before it was recorded stalled the supervisor forever (UPGRADE_BLOCKED, re-bootstrap refused) -> exactly one AUT1B recovery tick records it through the idempotent merge, then the governed upgrade runs

MEDIUM BS1-COV-1 the running AUT1B tick could keep reviewing and merging after it merged the launcher package -> the running tick is watched every 15 s and its tree is stopped once the default branch holds a recorded governed launcher merge; the loop upgrades in the same run

MEDIUM BS1-ENTRY-02 the sleep reset of the heartbeat watch erased accumulated staleness, so a hung daemon on a PC that sleeps daily was never killed -> awake-time accounting: a sleep gap counts one interval and the accumulated time is kept

MEDIUM BS1-ENTRY-03 a lock left by a supervisor killed at logoff was never cleared when Windows reused its PID -> provably stale locks (before the last boot, exited holder, PID reused after the lock) are removed before the plane runs, with an identity re-read and an event log entry

MEDIUM BS1-FLOW-01 activation could not replace a dangling control junction, so re-running after a plane directory was deleted always failed -> switchJunction unlinks any existing link even if its target is gone; the entry also repairs a dangling link to the recorded plane

LOW BS1-FLOW-02 a plane left by an interrupted clone/checkout was reused and refused forever -> an inactive plane is repaired with Git isolation (fetch, reset --hard, detached checkout, clean except node_modules)

LOW BS1-FLOW-03/FLOW-06/COV-5 failed, unconfirmed or interrupted first-run records stayed wrong while the task kept running -> the entry settles pending statuses and recovers FIRST_RUN_FAILED/NOT_CONFIRMED after the first success (tick TICK_DONE or fresh daemon heartbeat); the bootstrap keeps a status the entry already settled, prints state changes while polling and says when a re-run is not needed
LOW BS1-FLOW-04 first-run freshness was measured from the bootstrap start -> measured from Start-ScheduledTask
LOW BS1-FLOW-05 the bootstrap refused to repair its own task after a node or repository path change -> its own task is recognised by the wrapper path prefix

LOW BS1-ENTRY-04 ticks that did no work (ALREADY_RUNNING, LEASE_HELD, NO_CONTROL_STATE) were reported healthy and could confirm the first run -> reported unhealthy (TICK_DID_NO_WORK) and only TICK_DONE confirms or settles
LOW BS1-ENTRY-05/COV-2 an unguarded heartbeat rename could crash the entry while the bootstrap read the file -> retried rename with a copy fallback, and heartbeat writes never end the loop

LOW BS1-SEC-2 installed copies were checked against the live source file, not the verified blob -> verified files are staged right after the provenance check and every later use and the installed copies are checked against the verified blob ids; the script hash is taken at start

LOW BS1-COV-3 the test-mode guard accepted the real LocalApplicationData when TEMP was one of its parents -> Test-TestModeRoots refuses the real LocalApplicationData or any parent of it (pure path unit test; a filesystem test would risk the real control root)
LOW BS1-COV-4 evidence counts and the probe wording were stale -> counts, mutation commit and the probe working directory are stated precisely
LOW BS1-INT-02 the docs implied every entry fix arrives through governed merges -> the contracts the installed copy relies on before delegating are listed under 'When a new bootstrap is needed'
refutedSummary: BS1-SEC-1 the governed-merge check runs the plane library before deciding (skeptic: ordering accurate, claimed impact does not hold)
BS1-SEC-3 provenance accepts any clean commit (skeptic: step 4 checks integrity and records provenance; the reviewed, hash-pinned commit is chosen by the Founder)
BS1-SEC-4 link repair and plane imports precede the Global Stop check (skeptic: ordering real, no unsafe effect)
BS1-SEC-5 -TestMode -ProbeTaskRegistration registers a task (skeptic: the probe is its own explicit mode and removes its disabled task)
notTestedByDesign: the own-task prefix recognition, the Start-ScheduledTask freshness bound and the bootstrap/entry hand-off of a settled status run only on the real Task Scheduler path; they are covered by code review and by the entry-side settlement tests
the staged-copy TOCTOU closure would need a concurrent modification of the source during the run

fixRoundVerification.workflow: bs1-fix-round-adversarial-verification (four lenses on 8e4422d: entry fixes, bootstrap fixes, new risks, interaction with the real AUT1B/AUT2 engines; one skeptic per finding)
fixes: MEDIUM stale-lock cleanup did not cover bootstrap activation -> activatePlane clears a provably stale lock before taking the single-worker lock

MEDIUM in-place repair of an inactive plane failed on a leftover index.lock or untracked files, and the entry's upgrade candidate had no repair at all -> an unusable inactive plane or upgrade candidate is renamed aside (never deleted) and cloned again

MEDIUM a hard kill of the running AUT1B tick could leave a git index.lock in a review clone -> the tick is stopped only at a safe point: no action other than REVIEW in flight and no git process in its tree (process list unreadable = not stopped)
LOW the killed tick's unexpired lease idled the AUT2 daemon for up to 240 minutes -> the lease of a dead worker is released in the activation transition under the single-worker lock
LOW the boot-time test removed a lock without proof the holder was dead (clock step) -> liveness and creation time decide first; boot time only when the creation time is unknown
LOW a daemon that never completed a tick could confirm or settle the first run -> only a fresh heartbeat with lastTick counts; a launcher still running at the deadline is INSTALLED_FIRST_TICK_PENDING

PROCESS the mutation run of 8e4422d was interrupted because the working tree was edited while it ran; its partial output is discarded and the mutation set is re-run in a separate worktree on the final commit

round3Verification.workflow: bs1-round3-adversarial-verification (three lenses on 21ff472: runtime correctness, bootstrap and safety, test validity; one skeptic per finding)
fixes: HIGH the safe-point rule never stopped an old tick that cascaded into the release lane (in the live queue DR2 and BS1 are held, so this needs the holds to fail) -> a release in the packaging/signing/Phase0 lane stops the tick at once; merges of packages already reviewed CLEAN that the tick runs back to back may still complete and are disclosed in the docs and the review spec
LOW a stopped review could leave a half-installed node_modules that later reviews reuse -> after the stop, node_modules without the dependency marker in review and remediation clones is renamed aside
LOW the safe-point state was read before a multi-second process listing -> the state stamp must be unchanged across the listing
LOW a launcher that ended without a completed daemon tick left the first run pending forever -> settled as FIRST_RUN_FAILED; the bootstrap also waits up to 15 minutes for the daemon first tick
LOW any daemon lastTick counted as success, including LEASE_HELD -> only lastTick TICK_DONE (Test-DaemonTickCompleted, entry watch)
LOW the tick-PID wiring of the safe point was untested and failed open -> an invalid PID is never stoppable, and an end-to-end case keeps a git.exe child alive and proves the stop waits for it
notCoveredByTests: the state-stamp re-check needs a concurrent state change during the process listing
the 15-minute daemon wait and Test-DaemonTickCompleted in the wait loop run only on the real Task Scheduler path (the function itself is unit-tested)

round4Verification.workflow: bs1-round4-adversarial-verification (two lenses on af87242: correctness against the real AUT1B/AUT2 engines, safety and test validity; one skeptic per finding)
fixes: MEDIUM the half-installed node_modules was renamed inside the clone, leaving it dirty so the next plane could never review that package -> moved into quarantine in the control root, outside every clone

MEDIUM a daemon whose first tick succeeded and then self-upgraded (exit 0 without lastTick) was recorded as FIRST_RUN_FAILED -> the heartbeat is read once more at launcher end; a governed self-upgrade or Global Stop is no verdict; only a non-zero exit or a hang kill fails a pending record; the bootstrap treats LAUNCHER_EXITED with exit 0 as no verdict

LOW the release-lane stop could cut a package merge or remediation -> only a release action in flight stops the tick at once; a waiting release keeps the safe-point rule (the relaxation that let the recovery tick run while a release waited was withdrawn after the second CLAUDE_REVIEWER round)

round5Verification.workflow: bs1-round5-adversarial-verification (one lens on 95791d0 with one skeptic per finding)
fixes: LOW [int] narrowing of a launcher exit code above Int32 (Windows NTSTATUS codes) threw under PowerShell 5.1 StrictMode -> parsed as Int64 with TryParse, unit cases for 4294967295 and 3221225477
LOW the two launcher-end rules hid each other in the only test -> separate cases: exit 0 without a heartbeat, and a self-upgrade or Global Stop heartbeat with a non-zero exit, each stays pending
